profile.headline: Platform Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer now focused on Cloud Architecture/Operations and running modern microservice architectures at scale.  Experience in SaaS, PaaS, Agile methodology and Continuous Integration/Deployment via GitOps.  

My explorations can be found at https://fabianlee.org

positions.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the 24x7 availability of Platforms that enable a suite of Enterprise Productivity/Content Management applications deployed on Google Kubernetes Engine GKE, Google Anthos on-prem for VMware, Kubernetes CFCR, and CloudFoundry PaaS platform.

* Developed GitLab pipeline that enabled scalability of GitOps across fleet of Kubernetes clusters
* Developed Bash/Ansible utility that provisioned Google infrastructure, GKE cluster, and secure Ingress
* Developed Ansible/Terraform wizard that provisioned standardized vCenter Ubuntu
jumpboxes used across global datacenters
* Developed Python CLI utility that enabled promotion cycle to be applied uniformly across lower and production environments for 30 CloudFoundry microservices
* Developed Docker image for reporting Kubernetes cluster inventory on a nightly basis, replacing
manual documentation
* Developed GitLab pipeline for applying standard New Relic alert policy to Kubernetes clusters using Terraform
* Migrated existing GCP infrastructure resources into Terraform state management including complex module definitions
* Developed Bash wizard to fix health of PosgreSQL cluster, enabling junior resources to restore PostgeSQL to healthy state
positions.insights: Skills: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · python · Site Reliability Engineering · Software Observability · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Cloud Architect, Documentum OnDemand
positions.description:
Designed and deployed Documentum Content Management solutions to the Enterprise private Cloud that were highly available, scalable, observable, and paired with automated scripts to reduce the manual work required to operate this Cloud platform at scale.

Developed custom application monitoring agents in Java Spring, used PingIdentity Java API to retrofit SAML SSO in 4 different web applications, and developed/tested disaster recovery plan for audit.

* Used SaltStack to deploy ElasticSearch clusters with federated search that provided production log analysis for Engineers, eliminating manual 24-hour turnaround
* Led fundamental design change of SaaS application packaging from manually built vCenter ISO images to scripted deployment, which saved hundreds of man-hours
* Built Quality Assurance team a nightly vCenter rebuild pipeline, allowing them to close JIRA issues daily, instead of waiting until next 14 day sprint
* Built Java Spring agent that deployed on each VM as part of scripted stack provisioning process, returning custom metrics set based on app type paired to Zabbix alerts
* Wrote the SAML authentication plugins for the Documentum-as-a-Service platform, eliminating the need for custom passwords and enabling SSO for enterprise customers
* Championed technical side of LifeScience regulatory compliance

positions.title: Premium Designated Support Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with largest of EMC's Fortune 100 enterprise customers to resolve issues in their multi-tiered Documentum deployments at both the technical as well as relationship level.    Analyzed issues through all layers of delivery from browser, through app server, back to database queries where we could analyze raw database performance and recommend changes.

* Developed a desktop based C# application that allowed our Support team to monitor customer case responses, improving my team’s customer response times and avoiding case stagnation
* Developed an MS Outlook plugin using C# that allowed emails to be sent directly to Oracle case management system, net savings of $260K/yr based on Six Sigma analysis
* Presenter at EMC World conference and active leader in the EMC Community Forums, held #2 ranking in reputation points for assisting community with technical questions

positions.title: Practice Director, D.C.
positions.description:
Project Manager working on new account creation solution with global developer team.  Worked on federal contracts as well as  international financial clients on upgrades and design of their Documentum repositories.

* Project manager for FINDOCS, a financial services portal for new account creation and credit risk management
* Developer on Java component-based framework for the US Patent and Trade Organization
* Worked on-site in Mexico City with large Bank for critical Documentum Upgrade, established relationships and grew work to include Legal team

positions.title: Sr. Consultant
positions.description:
Extended J2EE web frameworks on top of Documentum to deliver publishing solution to large government organization that would bring publishing time down from 6 months to less than 2 weeks.  I was responsible for end user interface, and several backend components including those for XML/XSL transformations.

* Developed web ePublishing solution for US Patent and Trademark Office that brought their publishing turnaround time from 6 months to less than two weeks
* Wrote a series of articles for the public Documentum Community site on custom AJAX components
* Contributed expertise toward Documentum’s certification program at week long on-site program
* Developed automated build process for web development team using AntHill
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Documentum · XML · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Project Manager/Architect
positions.description:
Manager and Lead Developer of several J2EE and ASP web applications used for intra-office content management as well as use by international field offices with limited network throughput and high latency.  Managed and mentored junior developers on each major project.

* Manager and Lead Developer of the Chemonics Knowledge Base, an internal Java web application that provided browse/search capabilities to NGO consultants located in 86 international field offices
* Lead Coordinator for several Documentum release cycles, used sign-off sheets and schedule socialized with business groups
* Architect of bulk import project of 1.5 million documents from Windows shared drive to Documentum, developed ASP.NET app that enabled self-service metadata tagging by business groups
* Introduced Bug Tracking process into the group with a customized version of Bugzilla, enabling work assignment and tracking
* Managed junior developers on each major project and was directly responsible for their professional development and reviews
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Documentum · Issue Tracking · Management

positions.title: Senior Consultant/Project Manager
positions.description:
Managed and led ITIL processes re-engineering project at large financial credit institution.  Continually participated in sales calls and wrote Statements of Work that generated revenue throughout employment.

* Managed and led $1.1 million dollar project of five consultants implementing ITIL at large Credit Card issuer
* Developed POC for real-time delivery solution for NY Finance firm using MQ Server messaging
* Led the technical assessment of a J2EE application that was being licensed for use in credit card fraud management
* Wrote a domain specific language in Java to implement a medical HIPAA 287 XML message exchange between a health care provider and Blue Cross Blue Shield
* Managed and led team responsible for setting up a highly-available Netscape LDAP service for a large VOIP provider
* Developed internal training documentation - PowerPoint decks and example source code to bring consultants up-to-speed on: Component based architectures, SOA, Spring, Hibernate, Ant, and Test driven development
positions.insights: Skills: Java · U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · WebSphere MQ · Sun One LDAP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rewrote the Java Ariba integration of the core project to use flexible configuration rules that removed 6 week delay from on-boarding of our Fortune 100 customers.  Developed shipping domain Java library capable of unifying company's core shipping activities across Fedex/DHL/Airborne/UPS.  Member of company's European security working group.

* Rewrote the enterprise Ariba integration of the core product to use XML based rules versus hard coded Java class logic, saving 6 week test cycle
* Developed domain library in Java to unify the company’s core shipping activities across Fedex/DHL/Airborne/UPS
* Implemented Tomcat clustering with session replication to support SLA uptime requirements
* Introduced Continuous Integration pipeline to Java portion of shipping solution using AntHill, which added release management and testing
* Designed and implemented account security policy module in Perl
positions.insights: Skills: Perl · Java · SAP Ariba · Tomcat · Web Application Development

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Wrote and extended J2EE web frameworks for support of web publishing solutions, ad delivery systems, bulk document scanning, taxonomy manipulation, etc.  Elevated  profile with several public articles on content management as well as frequent contributions to Documentum public forums.  Assisted in writing statements of work/scope for sales process.

* Wrote a custom J2EE web framework that supported publishing content to Sun Microsystem’s main web site
* Prototyped J2EE solution with Southwest Airlines to receive invoice messages from a legacy mainframe via IBM MQ
*Wrote a J2EE web application that adapted Sun's taxonomy SOAP service to a web interface for end users
* Built a custom J2EE web interface to Documentum for the marketing group at Sun Microsystems using WDK components
* Developed the J2EE Swing interface for the DIXI product an XML driven app for migrations
* Created J2EE web-based Issue Tracker with Documentum backend
* Wrote a J2EE web based application for large energy company to enable them to modify their table metadata without requiring DBA assistance
* Wrote public Blog articles on WDK customization and the JDBC eConnector as well as moderating on the dmdeveloper support board
positions.insights: Skills: J2EE Application Development · Documentum · XML · Web Application Development

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Managed the everyday operations of startup development team.  Was Lead Developer of the Java based advertising animation platform, and constructed first versions of back-end analytics platform and Windows GUI app where ads were built by graphic designers.

* Lead Developer of advertising animation platform using Java multi-threaded applet with plugin support for key frame animation, multimedia, streaming voice, and wavelet image compression that was used for serving ads
* Constructed first version of the StarLight application, a VC++ Win32 MFC application that allows graphic designers to visually build ads
* Developed first version of web-based analytical reporting system, used an ASP web interface accessing Oracle 8.0 and an integration into the RealMedia Ad server
* Managed the everyday operations of product development group that consisted of seven employees  set objectives, evaluated performance
* Managed goals for Quality Assurance staff of three and assisted in creating test scripts
* Developed proof of concepts and technical presentations that led to receipt of venture capital during due diligence process
positions.insights: Skills: Java · ASP.NET · Microsoft Foundation Class (MFC) · web application · Ad Serving

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Wrote system for daily email reports to upper management based on network traffic, alerts, and erlang equations for link utilization.  Wrote web server in C++ using WinSock to expose legacy database, real time SNMP monitor in Java.

* Wrote the company’s first web server in C++ using WinSock library
* Built a web-based mail list server to send messages to all subscribers
* Built daily email report showing graphed network traffic/errors, and capacity planning for pool of telephony cards scraped nightly logs using Perl
* Wrote a Java interface to monitor SNMP devices in real-time
* Built an SNMP agent in Perl that auto mapped the network looking for additional devices and interfaces
* Implemented security policy module in Win32 MFC for flagship product using C++

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Created scalable and distributed ASP web application for SNMP monitoring of 1200+ devices in the Sabre network.  Measured Travelocity web latency using Windows C++ TAPI dialing capabilities dialing into geographically remote cities all over North America.

* Created scalable and distributed system for SNMP monitoring of American Airline’s global network of 1200 network devices, providing alerts and capacity planning
* Measured Travelocity.com latency using Windows C TAPI dialing capabilities to dial into ISPs at geographically distant cities, leading to re-evaluation of peering with MCI
* Built generic Java applet graphing library used by the rest of the development team that allowed them to easily expose their CSV datasets graphically
positions.insights: Skills: Java Applets · SNMP · ASP.NET · Internet Information Services (IIS) · Visual C++
